description: The plot illustrates the relative change in an unspecified metric across different layers, comparing various configurations of token count and bit precision. The x-axis is labeled with layer ranges (Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, Layer29-32) and has a categorical scale. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" with a linear scale, ranging from -25% to 5% in increments of 5%. The plot includes five lines representing different configurations: LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit (brown, circle marker, solid line), LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit (red, square marker, solid line), RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit (blue, circle marker, solid line), RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit (dark blue, square marker, solid line), and Baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit (gray, dashed line). The brown line starts at approximately -1% and ends at around -0.5%, remaining relatively stable across the x-axis. The red line begins at around -1.5% and ends at approximately -0.5%, showing a slight decrease before increasing. The blue line starts at about -2%, decreases to around -8% at Layer13-20, and then increases to approximately -2% at Layer29-32. The dark blue line begins at around -3%, sharply decreases to about -24% at Layer13-20, and then increases to approximately -4% at Layer29-32. The gray dashed line remains constant at 0% across the x-axis.
